```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(playaxr)
library(plotly)
```


```{r}
read_msg_log <- function(fname) {
  print(glue::glue("Read file {fname}"))
  pipe(glue::glue("grep 'mix-transport-messages' {fname}")) |> 
    stream_in() |> 
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(
      across(everything(), ~ if_else(. == "", NA, .)),
      node = as.integer(str_match(basename(fname), "^node-([0-9]+)\\.log$")[, 2])
    )
}

read_experiment <- function(folder, label) {
  lapply(
    list.files(
      folder, 
      pattern = "*.log", 
      full.names = TRUE
    ), 
    read_msg_log
  ) |> 
    bind_rows() |>
    mutate(
      ts = as.POSIXct(ts),
      experiment = label
    )
}
```

```{r}
logs <- read_experiment(
  "../output/push-unconstrained/logs/",
  "push_unconstrained"
) |> bind_rows(
  read_experiment(
    "../output/push-pull-unconstrained/logs/",
    "push_pull_unconstrained"
  )
) |> bind_rows(
  read_experiment(
    "../output/new-push-pull-unconstrained/logs/",
    "new_push_pull_unconstrained"
  )
)

```

## Counts

```{r}
options(ark.plot.width = 10)
options(ark.plot.height = 6)

ggplot(logs |>
  group_by(experiment, kind, direction) |>
  count()) + 
  geom_bar(
    aes(x = kind, y = n, fill = direction), position = "dodge2", stat = "identity"
  ) + 
  scale_y_abbrv() +
  ylab('messages (count)') +
  xlab('message type') + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  big_fonts(15) + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ experiment)
```

```{r}
options(ark.plot.width = 10)
options(ark.plot.height = 6)

plotly::ggplotly(ggplot(logs |>
  mutate(time = as.POSIXct(trunc.POSIXt(ts, units = 'secs'))) |>
  filter(direction == 'out') |>
  group_by(experiment, kind, time) |>
  count()) +
  geom_point(aes(x = time, y = n, col = kind)) +
  ylab('messages (count)') +
  xlab('time') +
  theme_minimal() +
  big_fonts(15) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ experiment, scale = 'free_x'))
```

## Latency

```{r}
# This is one awful transform. Splitting the table into stream and connection
# would probably do wonders.
latencies <- logs |>
  filter(kind %in% c("Connect", "ConnectAck", "OpenStream", "StreamAck")) |> 
  dplyr::select(experiment, sessionId, streamId, kind, direction, ts) |>
  group_by(experiment, sessionId, streamId, kind, direction) |>
  slice_min(ts, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(kind, direction), values_from = ts) |>
  mutate(
    connect.latency = Connect_in - Connect_out,
    connect.time = Connect_out,
    connect.is_received = !is.na(Connect_in),
    connect_ack.latency = ConnectAck_in - ConnectAck_out,
    connect_ack.time = ConnectAck_out,
    connect_ack.is_received = !is.na(ConnectAck_in),
    open_stream.latency = OpenStream_in - OpenStream_out,
    open_stream.time = OpenStream_out,
    open_stream.is_received = !is.na(OpenStream_in),
    stream_ack.latency = StreamAck_in - StreamAck_out,
    stream_ack.time = StreamAck_out,
    stream_ack.is_received = !is.na(StreamAck_in)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-c(
    Connect_out,
    Connect_in,
    ConnectAck_out,
    ConnectAck_in,
    OpenStream_out,
    OpenStream_in,
    StreamAck_out,
    StreamAck_in
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    ends_with("latency"),
    names_to="latency.type",
    values_to="latency"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(latency)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    ends_with("time"),
    names_to="time.type",
    values_to="time"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(time)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    ends_with("is_received"),
    names_to="is_received.type",
    values_to="is_received"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    message_type = stringr::str_split_i(latency.type, "\\.", i = 1)
  ) |>
  filter(
    stringr::str_split_i(is_received.type, "\\.", i = 1) == message_type
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-latency.type, -time.type, -is_received.type) 
```


```{r}
ggplot(latencies) + 
  geom_point(
    aes(x = time, y = latency)
  ) + 
  ylab('latency (seconds)') +
  xlab('time') +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(col = 'reply at end') +
  big_fonts(15) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ experiment, scale = 'free_x')
```
